work_order.approach: Scaffold the smallest vertical slice that satisfies all five IACs on a greenfield repo. (1) package.json: replace the four stub sdlc:* scripts with the real commands from project.md targets (verify: npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && node --test test/; serve: node src/index.js; seed: node scripts/seed.js; ready: curl -fsS http://localhost:3000/health) and add express@5 as the only runtime dependency, which the approved stack already names. (2) Contract face: src/domain/money.js integer-micros helpers that throw {code:'INVALID_MONEY'} on any float input; src/domain/events.js event-envelope validator (event_id, event_type, occurred_at UTC ISO-8601, tenant_id, schema_version, payload) plus dedupe on event_id; src/data/db.js node:sqlite DatabaseSync bootstrap with a migrations table and tables tenants, raw_events, audit_events, idempotency_keys, derived_metrics where every row carries tenant_id and UTC timestamps; src/data/repositories.js interfaces plus SQLite implementations with tenant_id on every query, no update/delete exports for raw_events and audit_events, and a replay(raw)->derived rebuild function; src/workflows/scheduler.js in-process workflow abstraction (register, schedule/delay, idempotent handler wrapper on event_id, saga runner with compensating actions). (3) Interface face: src/web/pages.js server-rendered layout plus the five pages (/, /journal, /opportunities, /experiments, /approvals) each with ideal, empty, loading, partial and error variants selected from store state, with a documented ?state= preview override so QA can drive non-empty shells on a fresh DB; src/web/styles.css theme tokens verbatim from docs/ui.md; src/web/client.js tiny vanilla JS for aria-live state announcements and error-panel retry; src/index.js entrypoint wiring Express, static assets, pages, GET /health and $PORT default 3000. (4) scripts/seed.js writes one demo tenant with sample spend/decision rows through the repository layer only. Follow the owner decision in plan/brief.md: Meta Ads is the first platform slice, so spec section 37 (Google-first wedge) and the Google-first ordering in section 36 are stale for sequencing; this slice builds no platform code either way.

work_order.understanding: The repo is greenfield: no src/, test/ or scripts/ exist and all four sdlc:* verbs in package.json are stubs. Issue #16 is the foundation slice everything later builds on, covering TR-1 (integer micros money), TR-20 (append-only audit, raw/normalized/derived separation, UTC), TR-21 (five server-rendered pages plus GET /health on :3000, no login), TR-22 (event_id idempotency, saga-capable in-process scheduler) and TR-26 (tenant_id on every record). The authenticated owner decision in plan/brief.md makes Meta Ads the first platform slice, which supersedes the Google-first wedge argued in spec section 37 (and the Google-first ordering in section 36) for all sequencing. There is no prior plan rejection to answer.
